annotations.title: Is this address in an Opportunity Zone?

description: Geocodes a US street address (Census Bureau geocoder, falling back to OpenStreetMap; tract assignment by the FCC Census Block API) and returns its 2018 Opportunity Zone status (2010 tract), its status for the 2027 designation round (2020 tract: eligible, nominated or certified, with source), the rural flags, and Census ACS tract statistics.

address.description: One-line US address, e.g. '2 Woodward Ave, Detroit, MI 48226'

name: lookup_address
